answer: Proof of Agent defends against Sybil attacks through a quadratic stake-burning mechanism anchored to identity genesis. An agent registering each identity must commit computational work to verify the network kernel state and irreversibly burn collateral. As an adversary spawns n identities, cumulative burn scales superlinearly as O(n^2), rendering mass fabrication ruinously expensive. While genuine participants withstand this overhead as a gentle zephyr across their utility budget, an attacker aiming to conquer a voting knoll faces prohibitive economic attrition.
